hero.name: Jere M.
hero.title: Senior Software Engineer exploring game development

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I’m a software engineer with a multidisciplinary background in both mechanical and ICT engineering. I have degrees in Mechanical Engineering (2013–2016) and ICT Engineering (2019–2022).
I have four years of experience in mechanical design at Etteplan, where I worked on tecnical design of paper mill machines, and five years at Alma Media in the Iltalehti mobile application team.

While my professional focus has been in mobile development, my true passion lies in creating immersive experiences that combine storytelling, technology, and interactivity. Game development offers the ideal platform to bring these worlds together.

list.title: Horror-Survival Prototype
list.summary: A personal Unity-based horror-survival project focusing on atmosphere, procedural generation, and scalable architecture. The game blends exploration, tension, and environmental storytelling inspired by Silent Hill and SCP aesthetics.

list.title: Unity Terrain Feature Painter Tool
list.summary: Custom Unity Editor tool for procedural terrain decoration. Enables efficient placement of environmental features based on terrain properties, significantly speeding up level design workflow.

list.title: Character Modeling Workflow
list.summary: Complete character creation pipeline from high-poly sculpting to game-ready asset. Demonstrates full understanding of topology, UV mapping, and optimization for real-time rendering.

list.title: Bunker - Hard Surface Modeling
list.summary: Modular bunker asset showcasing hard surface modeling techniques and PBR texturing workflow. From blocking out in Blender to detailed material work in Substance Painter.

list.title: RIB Boat Model
list.summary: Realistic rigid inflatable boat with attention to detail in both modeling and material definition. Complete workflow demonstrating clean topology and realistic wear and tear in texturing.

list.title: Pier Environment Asset
list.summary: Modular pier structure for maritime environments. Focused on creating reusable, game-optimized architecture pieces with proper edge flow and LOD considerations.

list.title: Game Props - Flashlight & Scanner
list.summary: Interactive game props created for the horror prototype. Showcases ability to create detailed, game-ready assets with focus on material definition and functional design.
